sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，体内的血也被放干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 看来凶手煞费苦心地隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，人们只知道她叫无名氏。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 随后，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫阿达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是 Casefile Presents 推出的全新系列节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: Mount Macedon looms 65 kilometres northwest of Melbourne City, its tree-clad mountainous peak overshadowing a small, Goldrush-era heritage township bearing its namesake.
sentences.zh: 马其顿山耸立在墨尔本市西北方向65公里处，其树木繁茂的山峰俯瞰着一个同名的淘金热时期历史小镇。

sentences.en: From the summit, Mount Macedon provides a sprawling, scenic view of the surrounding native forests and rural Victorian countryside, with the cityscape in the far distance.
sentences.zh: 从山顶眺望，马其顿山可以欣赏到周围原生森林和维多利亚州乡村的壮丽景色，远处则是城市风光。

sentences.en: Several creeks branch out from the mountain, including two that feed into the much larger
sentences.zh: 几条小溪从山上分流而出，其中两条汇入面积大得多的

sentences.en: Maribyrnong River, a winding 40-kilometre waterway that heads chiefly southward through the factory districts and residential suburbs of the northwestern fringe of the city, before
sentences.zh: 马里比尔农河，这是一条蜿蜒40公里的水道，主要向南流经该市西北边缘的工厂区和住宅区，然后

sentences.en: joining Melbourne's central waterway, the Yarra River, eventually emptying into Port Phillip Bay.
sentences.zh: 汇入墨尔本的中心水道雅拉河，最终注入菲利普港湾。

sentences.en: As the second major river in metropolitan Melbourne, the Maribyrnong originally served as an arterial shipping route in the city's west, fostering the development of the
sentences.zh: 作为墨尔本大都市的第二大河流，马里比尔农河最初是该市西部的主干航运路线，促进了该地区

sentences.en: area's industrial growth.
sentences.zh: 工业的发展。

sentences.en: As a result, the quality of the water degraded, with decades of contamination, pollution and litter turning the river a murky brown colour.
sentences.zh: 因此，水质恶化，数十年的污染和垃圾使河水变成浑浊的棕色。

sentences.en: In recent times, most of the riverside industry has been closed, with the Maribyrnong re-established as a recreational hub for boating, fishing, rowing and cruises.
sentences.zh: 近年来，大部分河畔工业已经关闭，马里比尔农河被重新规划为划船、钓鱼、赛艇和游船的娱乐中心。

sentences.en: An abundance of bushland, parks and sporting fields now border the length of the river, which is framed by various bike paths and walking trails.
sentences.zh: 如今，河岸两侧有大量林地、公园和运动场，并点缀着各种自行车道和步行小径。

sentences.en: At around midday on Thursday February 5, 2015, two walkers were strolling along the eastern banks
sentences.zh: 2015年2月5日星期四中午左右，两名散步者正沿着

sentences.en: of the Maribyrnong River in Moonee Ponds, a suburb six kilometres out of Melbourne.
sentences.zh: 距离墨尔本6公里的卫星城莫尼蓬兹的马里比尔农河东岸漫步。

sentences.en: They passed the renowned Boathouse Restaurant, owned by celebrity chef Gary Megan, which was bustling as usual.
sentences.zh: 他们路过了由名厨加里·梅根经营的著名船屋餐厅，这里一如既往地热闹。

sentences.en: As was the Angler's Tavern, a riverside pub located a little further downstream on the adjacent shore.
sentences.zh: 稍下游相邻岸边的一家河畔酒吧 Angler's Tavern 也是如此。

sentences.en: The Maribyrnong Park, which flanks the popular eatery, was full of visitors, dog walkers, joggers and children enjoying the warm summer day.
sentences.zh: 这家受欢迎的餐馆旁边的马里比尔农公园里挤满了游客、遛狗者、慢跑者和享受温暖夏日的儿童。

sentences.en: At 1.30pm, as the pair continued along the palm and gum tree lined track, they noticed something floating upstream in the murky waters of the river.
sentences.zh: 下午1点30分，当两人继续沿着这条棕榈树和桉树环绕的小径前行时，他们注意到河里浑浊的泥水中有什么东西顺流而上漂浮着。

sentences.en: It was a white plastic grocery bag with something inside.
sentences.zh: 那是一个白色的塑料杂货袋，里面装着东西。

sentences.en: Upon taking a closer look, they immediately contacted police who promptly arrived to the riverbank.
sentences.zh: 仔细一看，他们立即联系了警方，警察很快赶到了河岸。

sentences.en: Curious patrons of the nearby establishments watched on as officers stood on a wooden jetty and used a pole to fish the bag from the water.
sentences.zh: 附近店铺里好奇的顾客在一旁观望，警察则站在木栈桥上，用竿子把袋子从水里捞了上来。

sentences.en: They placed it on the jetty and peered inside, discovering the bag contained what appeared to be a reasonably fresh, severed, human limb.
sentences.zh: 他们把它放在栈桥上往里张望，发现袋子里装着的似乎是一截相当新鲜的断肢。

sentences.en: Officers at the scene conducted an initial examination of the limb and identified it to be the forearm of a Caucasian male, severed at the elbow and wriSt.
sentences.zh: 现场警员对断肢进行了初步检查，确认这是白人男性的前臂，在手肘和手腕处被切断。

sentences.en: They were certain the victim's hand had been intentionally removed to hinder efforts to identify the remains through fingerprint analysis.
sentences.zh: 他们确信受害者的手是被人故意割掉的，以此来阻碍通过指纹分析辨认遗体身份的努力。

sentences.en: There was only one distinguishable feature on the forearm, a faded tattoo of a devilish caricature
sentences.zh: 前臂上只有一个明显的特征：一个褪色的纹身，图案是一个恶魔般的卡通形象，

sentences.en: wearing baggy pants and holding a three-pronged pitchfork in its left hand, and what looked like a spray can in its right.
sentences.zh: 穿着宽松的裤子，左手拿着一把三叉戟，右手拿着类似喷漆罐的东西。

sentences.en: The grisly discovery sparked a full-scale search of the Maribyrnong River, which was an enormous,
sentences.zh: 这个可怕的发现引发了对马里比尔农河的全面搜查，这是一项规模宏大

sentences.en: and time-consuming task encompassing the Water Police, State Emergency Service, and the Police
sentences.zh: 且耗时巨大的任务，水警、州紧急服务局和警察搜救队均参与其中。

sentences.en: Search and Rescue Squad.
sentences.zh: 搜救队。

sentences.en: As the various teams began trudging the riverbank and its rocky surrounds, sifting through the
sentences.zh: 正当各支搜救队开始跋涉在河岸及其布满岩石的周边，仔细搜寻多年来积累的

sentences.en: junk and muck that had accumulated over the years, police divers in full scuba gear plunged into the shallow, murky waters to scour beneath the surface.
sentences.zh: 垃圾和污泥时，身穿全套水肺潜水装备的警察潜水员潜入浅而浑浊的水中，在水面下仔细搜寻。

sentences.en: Their vision was severely limited as they cautiously navigated around the large tree branches and submerged items that littered the riverbed.
sentences.zh: 由于河床布满了大树枝和水下杂物，他们小心翼翼地绕行，视线受到了严重限制。

sentences.en: In a slow and methodical process, police boats equipped with sonar equipment scanned the depths
sentences.zh: 警方搜救船装备了声纳设备，以缓慢而有条不紊的过程对河底进行扫描，

sentences.en: of the river two kilometres in either direction from the site of the discovery, overseen by a police helicopter circling above.
sentences.zh: 搜寻范围从发现地点向上游和下游两个方向各延伸两公里，头顶上方则有警用直升机盘旋监督。

sentences.en: Search efforts were complicated by the fact that the Maribyrnong was a tidal river influenced by
sentences.zh: 由于巴利玛农河是一条受菲力浦湾影响的潮汐河，

sentences.en: Port Phillip Bay, which sat at its large coastal mouth.
sentences.zh: 而菲力浦湾正位于其巨大的入海口，这给搜救工作带来了复杂的挑战。

sentences.en: The changing ocean tides altered the river's flow and water levels, causing debris to constantly shift directions up and downstream.
sentences.zh: 不断变化的海洋潮汐改变了河流的流向和水位，导致水中的杂物在上下游之间不断变换方向。

sentences.en: Police understood that if there were more human remains to be discovered in the waterway, they may have since been displaced and directed elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 警方明白，如果水域中还有更多的人类遗骸尚未被发现，它们可能已经位移并被冲到了其他地方。

sentences.en: It also meant the location where the forearm had been found wasn't necessarily the same place that had been originally discarded.
sentences.zh: 这也意味着发现前臂的地方不一定是最初抛尸的地点。

sentences.en: The intensive police presence caught the attention of the media and passing onlookers, who swarmed the scene to observe the grim search.
sentences.zh: 大批警力的出现引起了媒体和过往旁观者的注意，他们蜂拥至现场围观这场令人毛骨悚然的搜查。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, detectives began door-knocking the local area and collecting footage from security cameras located near the riverbank.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，侦探们开始在当地进行挨户走访，并收集河岸附近监控摄像头的录像。

sentences.en: The grisly discovery came as a shock to the residents of Moonee Ponds, where such horrific
sentences.zh: 这一骇人听闻的发现震惊了穆尼庞兹的居民，在这个备受推崇的时髦郊区，

sentences.en: crimes were unheard of in their esteemed and trendy suburb, populated by young professionals, families, and retirees.
sentences.zh: 居住着年轻专业人士、家庭和退休人员，这里从未发生过如此可怕的罪案。

sentences.en: Due to the method in which the body was dismembered and the perpetrators calculated efforts to conceal
sentences.zh: 由于尸体被肢解的方式以及作案者为掩盖死者身份而进行的蓄意图谋，

sentences.en: the victim's identity, rumours circulated as to whether the death was gang-related.
sentences.zh: 坊间开始流传这起死亡事件是否与帮派有关的谣言。

sentences.en: Just over three hours after the forearm was discovered, search crews had shifted two kilometres downstream to the suburb of Essendon WeSt.
sentences.zh: 在前臂被发现的三个多小时后，搜救人员已向下游移动了两公里，来到了埃森顿韦斯特郊区。

sentences.en: There, under the Abton Street pedestrian bridge, a popular dive spot for swimmers, police and state emergency service personnel spotted a second plastic bag in the water.
sentences.zh: 在那里，位于游泳爱好者热门跳水点的阿布顿街人行桥下方，警察和州紧急服务人员在水中发现了第二个塑料袋。

sentences.en: They pulled it out and discovered it contained another human limb, although this one was not as easily identifiable as the firSt.
sentences.zh: 他们将其捞出，发现里面装着另一截人类肢体，不过这一截不像第一截那么容易辨认。

sentences.en: Hours later, at 7pm, two kilometres upstream from where the forearm was originally sighted, police spotted a black plastic bag floating down the river.
sentences.zh: 数小时后的晚上7点，在最初发现前臂地点的上方两公里处，警方发现一个黑色塑料袋正顺流漂下。

sentences.en: Upon retrieving it, the bag contained what officers could only describe as a small amount of human flesh.
sentences.zh: 打捞上来后，袋子里装着警官们只能形容为少量的人类皮肉的东西。

sentences.en: The recovered human remains were sent to the Victorian Institute of Forensic Medicine for examination,
sentences.zh: 找回的人类遗骸被送往维多利亚法医研究所进行检验，

sentences.en: where forensic pathologists performed multiple autopsies to confirm all the body parts belonged to the same unidentified male.
sentences.zh: 法医病理学家在那里进行了多次尸检，以确认所有身体部位都属于同一个未识别的男性。

sentences.en: They also determined the remains had been in the river for up to seven days.
sentences.zh: 他们还确定这些遗骸在河里泡了长达七天。

sentences.en: It was clear to police that the victim had been murdered and dismembered elsewhere before the
sentences.zh: 警方清楚，受害者在别处被谋杀并分尸，然后

sentences.en: Maribyrnong had been used as a dumping ground to discard his remains.
sentences.zh: 马里比尔农河被用作抛尸地点来丢弃他的遗骸。

sentences.en: They were certain more body parts had yet to be discovered, but given the late hour and the lack of visibility, dive efforts were suspended until the following morning.
sentences.zh: 他们确信还有更多的身体部位尚未被发现，但鉴于时间已晚且能见度差，潜水搜寻工作暂停至次日清晨。

sentences.en: Search efforts continued on land overnight as the gruesome nature of the case put pressure on police to swiftly identify the victim and capture his killer.
sentences.zh: 由于案件的残忍性质给警方施加了迅速查明受害者身份并抓获凶手的压力，搜寻工作整夜在陆地上继续。

sentences.en: The next morning, Friday February 6, divers re-entered the river at first light as police continued to comb the adjoining landscape and surrounding streets.
sentences.zh: 次日清晨，即2月6日星期五，天刚亮潜水员就重新下水，而警方继续搜查临近的景观和周边街道。

sentences.en: After failing to uncover any further remains by midday, the focus of the search was shifted to the area surrounding the Afton Street Bridge, the site of the second discovery.
sentences.zh: 到中午仍未发现更多遗骸后，搜寻的重点转移到了第二次发现遗骸的阿夫顿街桥周边地区。

sentences.en: At 1.30pm, divers began extensively combing that portion of the river, but after hours of fruitless searching, were forced to call it a day.
sentences.zh: 下午1点30分，潜水员开始对河的那部分进行广泛搜寻，但经过数小时一无所获的搜寻后，被迫收工。

sentences.en: The next step for homicide detectives was to try and identify the victim using the only clue they had thus far, the distinctive forearm tattoo of the pitchfork-wielding devil.
sentences.zh: 凶杀案侦探的下一步是试图利用迄今为止唯一的线索——那个拿着草叉的恶魔的独特前臂纹身——来辨认受害者的身份。

sentences.en: They cross-checked the image with missing person reports and the criminal database, whilst making inquiries with local tattoo parlours and graffiti artists.
sentences.zh: 他们将该图像与失踪人员报告和犯罪数据库进行了交叉比对，同时向当地的纹身店和涂鸦艺术家进行了查询。

sentences.en: To hasten efforts, police released an image of the tattoo to the media in the hope that a member of the public might recognise the artwork and come forward.
sentences.zh: 为了加快工作进度，警方将纹身的照片公之于众，希望有公众能认出这幅艺术作品并站出来提供线索。

sentences.en: In an accompanying statement, Detective Inspector Mick Hughes stated,
sentences.zh: 在一份随附的声明中，侦探督察米克·休斯表示，

sentences.en: Detective Hughes expressed sympathy towards the victim's family, who would likely learn of their loved one's death from the ensuing media reports.
sentences.zh: 休斯侦探对受害者的家属表示同情，他们很可能会从随后的媒体报道中得知亲人的死讯。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: “引述：

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the search of the Maribyrnong River continued.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，对马里比尔农河的搜寻仍在继续。

sentences.en: The waters hadn't been closed off to the public, so rivergoers continued to populate the waterway as it was scoured for body parts.
sentences.zh: 河水并未对公众关闭，因此在搜寻身体部位的同时，河道上依然人来人往。

sentences.en: On the third morning of the police search, a woman took to the water in her rowboat and
sentences.zh: 在警方搜查的第三天，一名女子划着划艇下水，

sentences.en: headed towards the Maribyrnong Road Bridge in Moonee Ponds, near the location where the forearm was recovered.
sentences.zh: 朝着穆尼庞兹的马里比尔农路桥划去，那里正是找到前臂的地点附近。

sentences.en: At 11am, she spotted a plastic bag floating under the bridge and paddled over to take a closer look.
sentences.zh: 上午11点，她发现桥下漂浮着一个塑料袋，便划过去仔细查看。

sentences.en: Realising it contained flesh, she caught the attention of a passing police boat and used her paddle to push the bag over to the officers.
sentences.zh: 意识到里面装着肉块后，她引起了一艘路过警船的注意，并用船桨把袋子推向警员。

sentences.en: Three and a half hours later, two local men were walking their dogs alongside the river.
sentences.zh: 三个半小时后，两名当地男子带着狗在河边散步。

sentences.en: As they passed the Essendon Canoe Club on the adjacent side, they spotted a white plastic bag that had washed up on the riverbank and wedged between rocks.
sentences.zh: 当他们经过对岸的埃森登独木舟俱乐部时，发现一个白色塑料袋被冲上河岸，卡在岩石之间。

sentences.en: The men recognised a grey human knee protruding from the bag and immediately flagged down a police boat.
sentences.zh: 两人认出袋子里露出一截灰色的男性膝盖，随即向一艘警船挥手求助。

sentences.en: Reporters at the scene crowded around the men as one explained,
sentences.zh: 现场的记者围住这两人，其中一人解释道：

sentences.en: I feel awful.
sentences.zh: 我感觉糟透了。

sentences.en: It's someone.
sentences.zh: 那是个人啊。

sentences.en: Whilst the other described the discovery as surreal, adding,
sentences.zh: 而另一个人则将这次发现形容为超现实，并补充说：

sentences.en: Kids are enjoying a nice game of cricket and there's a body part floating near them.
sentences.zh: 孩子们正在开心地打板球，而他们附近却漂着一具尸体残肢。

sentences.en: As the two latest discoveries were within 200 metres of the Maribyrnong Road Bridge, police shifted their attention back to this area.
sentences.zh: 由于最近这两处发现距离马里比尔农路桥不到200米，警方将注意力重新转回了这一区域。

sentences.en: But after another day of searching, their efforts yielded no further discoveries.
sentences.zh: 但在又搜查了一天之后，他们的努力没有再带来任何新的发现。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the image of the forearm tattoo was circulating on news sites throughout Australia and as far away as the United Kingdom and New Zealand.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，那处前臂纹身的照片正在澳大利亚各地以及远至英国和新西兰的新闻网站上流传。

sentences.en: As no one had immediately come forward to identify the tattooed man, it was presumed he either had a little family or lived interstate or overseas.
sentences.zh: 由于没有人立即前来辨认这名有纹arm的男子，人们推测他要么没什么亲人，要么住在外州或海外。

sentences.en: Police had appealed for anyone with information to contact Crimestoppers, an organisation which allows people to provide anonymous information to authorities.
sentences.zh: 警方曾呼吁知情者联系灭罪热线，这是一个允许人们向当局提供匿名信息的组织。

sentences.en: The service was flooded with calls, but none led to the identity of the victim.
sentences.zh: 该热线接到了大量电话，但没有一个电话能指明受害者的身份。

sentences.en: Then, the Victoria Police Facebook page received messages from the public alerting them to a post on
sentences.zh: 随后，维多利亚州警察局的Facebook主页收到了公众发来的消息，提醒他们注意

sentences.en: the internet forum website Reddit, in which users had identified the origin of the tattoo's pitchfork wielding devil.
sentences.zh: 互联网论坛网站Reddit上的一个帖子，该帖子的用户已经认出了纹身上那个挥舞草叉的恶魔的来历。

sentences.en: The image was featured on a 1997 album titled Tooth and Nail, released by three-piece
sentences.zh: 这个形象出现在1997年的一张名为《Tooth and Nail》的专辑上，由三人

sentences.en: Australian punk band Downtime.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚朋克乐队Downtime发行。

sentences.en: The album's cover art depicted the exact same devil from the tattoo.
sentences.zh: 该专辑的封面艺术描绘的就是纹身上的那个一模一样的恶魔。

sentences.en: The only difference was that instead of a spray can in its right hand, Downtime's devil was holding a
sentences.zh: 唯一的区别是，Downtime的恶魔右手拿的不是喷漆罐，而是一束

sentences.en: bouquet of yellow arum lilies, an ornamental plant variety commonly displayed at funerals.
sentences.zh: 黄色的马蹄莲，这是一种通常在葬礼上摆放的观赏植物品种。

sentences.en: Given the similarities between the tattoo and the album's artwork, the web sleuths who made the connection speculated whether the victim was known to the band.

sentences.en: Although the band originally hailed from
sentences.zh: 尽管该乐队最初来自

sentences.zh: 事实证明，Downtime的贝斯手詹姆斯·米克是从一本滑板和涂鸦杂志抄袭了这个恶魔的艺术作品来作为他乐队的专辑封面的。

sentences.en: He had taken some creative liberties in his reproduction, giving the devil a bouquet of yellow lilies instead of the can of spray paint it held in the original magazine version.
sentences.zh: 他在复制时发挥了一些创意，给恶魔画了一束黄百合，而不是原版杂志里的喷漆罐。

sentences.en: The magazine artwork and the victim's tattoo were compared side by side, revealing an exact match.

sentences.en: Evolving news reports on the tattoo caught the attention of local Melbourne resident Ronald Whitmore, who arrived at the North Melbourne Police Station to inform officers that his

sentences.en: The last time Ronald had seen his son was over a month earlier on Christmas Day of 2014, but Brendan's lack of contact since the holiday was not unusual,

sentences.en: as he often went long periods of time without getting in touch.
sentences.zh: 因为他经常很长一段时间不和家里联络。

sentences.en: As such, the family had not been concerned about his whereabouts and he hadn't been reported as missing.
sentences.zh: 因此，家人并不担心他的行踪，也没有将他报案失踪。

sentences.en: Brendan's friends knew him simply as B and he wore a distinctive chain around his neck adorned with the letter.
sentences.zh: 布伦丹的朋友们简单地叫他B，他的脖子上戴着一条饰有这个字母的独特链子。

sentences.en: He was the eldest of four children, one of whom had since relocated to Europe, but the other two resided in Melbourne.
sentences.zh: 他是四个孩子中的老大，其中一人后来移居欧洲，但另外两人居住在墨尔本。

sentences.en: His mother had passed away in 2008.
sentences.zh: 他的母亲已于2008年去世。

sentences.en: For the past five years, Brendan had been homeless, intermittently staying at men's shelters until the end of 2012 when he took to couch surfing between the homes of his friends.
sentences.zh: 在过去的五年里，布伦丹一直无家可归，在男士收容所间歇性地居住，直到2012年底开始在朋友家之间过着沙发客的生活。

sentences.en: A long-term heroin user, he was also known to deal drugs which caused a rift between his family.
sentences.zh: 他长期吸食海洛因，也贩卖毒品，这导致他和家人之间产生了隔阂。

sentences.en: Although they did not agree with his life choices, they still cared deeply for

sentences.en: Brendan and hoped he would get his life back on track.

sentences.en: To determine if there was a familial connection, Ronald Whitmore provided investigators with his own DNA to compare against the unidentified remains, a significantly faster

sentences.en: process than checking the DNA against their extensive databases.
sentences.zh: 远胜于在庞大的数据库中核对DNA。

sentences.en: As police awaited the results of the test,
sentences.zh: 在警方等待检测结果的同时，

sentences.zh: 侦探督察米克·休斯面对媒体宣布，该纹身已被受害者的家属认出。

sentences.en: He disclosed the victim to be a man aged in his thirties who lived on the fringes of Melbourne's
sentences.zh: 他透露受害者是一名三十多岁的男子，生活在墨尔本市中心边缘地带，

sentences.en: CBD, but withheld Brendan Bernard's name, explaining he would not disclose his identity until the DNA had been confirmed through forensic testing.
sentences.zh: 但隐去了布伦丹·伯纳德的名字，并解释说在法医检测确认DNA之前，他不会透露其身份。

sentences.en: Although, he expressed confidence that they now knew who the victim was, remarking, everything points to that family's relative, adding that a motive for the murder and his exact
sentences.zh: 不过，他表示相信他们现在已经知道了受害者是谁，并评论道，一切都指向那个家庭的亲属，同时补充说谋杀动机以及他的确切

sentences.en: cause of death remained unclear.
sentences.zh: 死因仍不清楚。

sentences.en: Detective Hughes thanked the public and media for their support during the course of their investigations, stating, The response from the public has been tremendous.
sentences.zh: 休斯警探感谢公众和媒体在调查期间给予的支持，并表示：公众的反应非常巨大。

sentences.en: Despite the confronting nature of these discoveries, people have acted quickly and contacted police immediately.
sentences.zh: 尽管这些发现令人震惊，但人们行动迅速，并立即联系了警方。

sentences.en: The information provided has enabled investigators to act quickly and secure the items proving crucial in the investigation.

sentences.en: I'd appeal to the offender out there.

sentences.zh: 罗纳德·惠特莫尔的DNA检测结果呈阳性，证实了他与受害者之间确实存在亲缘关系。

sentences.en: This result, coupled with the tattoo identification, confirmed the Maribyrnong River remains were those of Brendan Bernard.
sentences.zh: 这一结果，再加上纹身的辨认，证实了马里比尔农河的遗骸正是布伦丹·伯纳德。

sentences.en: The verification devastated Brendan's family, who struggled to comprehend the depravity of his death and the horrific ordeal he suffered.
sentences.zh: 这一证实让布伦丹的家人悲痛欲绝，他们难以理解他死时的残忍以及他所遭受的可怕折磨。

sentences.en: Ronald provided police with a recent photograph of his deceased son to help with their investigations.
sentences.zh: 罗纳德向警方提供了一张他已故儿子近期的照片，以协助他们的调查。

sentences.en: It portrayed a smiling and relaxed Brendan as he stood at the tram stop on the corner of Gertrude and Napier Streets in Fitzroy.
sentences.zh: 照片中，面带微笑且放松的布伦丹正站在菲茨罗伊格特鲁德街和纳皮尔街交界处的电车站旁。

sentences.en: His shoulder-length brown hair was covered by a black hat which matched his black attire, a collection of keychains dangling around his neck.
sentences.zh: 他及肩的棕色头发戴着一顶与黑色着装相配的黑色帽子，脖子上挂着一串钥匙链。

sentences.en: The photo was released to the media, publicly naming Brendan Bernard as the man whose remains had been found in the river, and the hunt for his killer was initiated.
sentences.zh: 这张照片被公之于众，公开点名布伦丹·伯纳德就是遗体在河中被发现的男子，搜捕凶手的行动随即展开。

sentences.en: Homicide detectives extended their investigations to the locations Brendan was known to frequent and began questioning his relatives and friends.
sentences.zh: 凶杀案侦探将调查范围扩大到布伦丹生前经常出没的地方，并开始盘问他的亲友。

sentences.en: John Unkovich, Brendan's stepfather, came forward as one of the last people to have seen Brendan in the days preceding the discovery of his remains.
sentences.zh: 布伦丹的继父约翰·温科维奇主动站了出来，他是遗体被发现前几天最后见过布伦丹的人之一。

sentences.en: John maintained a good relationship with his stepson, with the pair having last seen each other on Tuesday January 27.
sentences.zh: 约翰与继子关系很好，两人最后一次见面是在1月27日星期二。

sentences.en: Nine days before Brendan's body parts were found, he met his stepfather outside John's city-based office, where he asked to borrow some money.
sentences.zh: 在布伦丹的尸块被发现的九天前，他在约翰位于市中心的办公室外面见到了继父，并向他借钱。

sentences.en: John agreed, transferring $100 into Brendan's bank account, but he hadn't heard from him since.
sentences.zh: 约翰同意了，向布伦丹的银行账户转了100美元，但自那以后就再也没有他的消息。

sentences.en: When John saw the devil tattoo in media reports, he immediately recognised it as similar to Brendan's, but the image was blurry so he wasn't 100% certain.
sentences.zh: 当约翰在媒体报道中看到那个恶魔纹身时，他立刻认出它与布伦丹的很相似，但图像很模糊，所以他不敢百分之百确定。

sentences.en: Wanting to make sure his stepson was alright,
sentences.zh: 为了确保继子平安无事，

sentences.en: John proceeded to try to find him.
sentences.zh: 约翰着手寻找他。

sentences.en: He knew Brendan was staying with a friend, Matthew Brennan, who lived in an apartment on O'Shaughnessy
sentences.zh: 他知道布伦丹和朋友马修·布伦南住在一起，后者住在奥肖内西街的一间公寓里，

sentences.en: Street in North Melbourne.
sentences.zh: 位于墨尔本北部。

sentences.zh: 这间公寓是澳大利亚政府拥有的多层公屋综合体的一部分，为低收入者和依赖社会福利的人提供住所。

sentences.en: welfare.
sentences.zh: 福利。

sentences.zh: 马修一直允许布伦丹免费暂住在他的住处。

sentences.en: When John visited the apartment looking for Brendan, Matthew seemed reluctant to open the door, informing him that Brendan had packed up his things and left the week prior.
sentences.zh: 当约翰去公寓找布伦丹时，马修似乎不愿意开门，并告诉他布伦丹已经在前一周收拾好行李离开了。

sentences.en: Detectives checked CCTV footage and were able to confirm that Brendan had met his stepfather in

sentences.zh: 中央商务区与继父见面，但无法追踪他从那以后的行踪。

sentences.en: They approached Matthew Brennan, finding him in the company of another friend,

sentences.zh: 康斯坦蒂诺斯·斯帕利亚里斯，他住在同一栋奥肖内西街公屋大楼里。

sentences.en: When asked about Brendan's whereabouts, Matthew and Constantinos told the officers that he had quote,

sentences.en: Matthew began psychological treatment in 2012, during which a doctor noted he had psychopathic features
